The '''floonorp''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument made of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine parts. During the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] Race, a group of [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] musicians in the stands played various horns, including the floonorp.
